commits.subject: Prevent duplicate initial context when injection races the first turn (#62206)
commits.reason: Use upstream's per-session publication permit so concurrent injection and the first turn persist a single initial context. The fork can continue to track which queue or durable writer received each injected item.
evidence: Reviewed all five changed paths against a4495dd5c9. Binary diff SHA-256 b5e484fbda7099d97430c8ee6de16ae45508b0d55a2e0237ea17b9fd03125cb8.

Both callers render outside the permit. The winner publishes the initial prefix and checkpoints under the permit. A losing turn renders its delta against the installed baseline, while a losing injection delivers its own items. The production and test session constructors all allocate one permit.

The local integration merged all five files cleanly. The retained-side hooks still annotate the original incoming items and record their actual active-queue or canonical-history route after context preparation.
commits.revisit: Exercise both preparation orders in first_turn_and_raw_injection_publish_one_initial_prefix. Verify one copy of the initial instructions and injection in the follow-up, one durable full snapshot, and recovery of retained side-conversation history.
